name: Navneet Education Ltd
title: Navneet Education Ltd - 508989 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue flat at INR394 crore vs INR389 crore while FY26 fell 3% to INR1,683 crore; management guides FY27 publication growth ~15% on curriculum change, but stationery margins compress to ~9% and capex is minimal.

utilisation.quote: On paper capacity, I would say we are quite highly utilized. So on an annual basis, I can say around 80%.

triggers.label: Paper prices up ~8% off lows
triggers.quote: the paper that we use in last 1 quarter, we have seen around 8% jump from its lowest level
triggers.highlight: around 8% jump from its lowest level

triggers.label: Publication growth ~15% from curriculum change
triggers.quote: we are clearly seeing growth of around 15% in a single year
triggers.highlight: growth of around 15% in a single year

triggers.label: Stationery EBITDA guided ~9% vs ~13%
triggers.quote: we should be making around 9% margin in the current year post these expenses
triggers.highlight: around 9% margin in the current year

triggers.label: UAE plant on hold; capex to INR25-30 crore
triggers.quote: we have kept it on hold due to ongoing geopolitical tensions

guidance.value: around 15% in a single year, at least first 2 years
guidance.quote: at least in the first 2 years, we are clearly seeing growth of around 15% in a single year
I would say single higher-digit growth will be an estimation, around 8% to 9%.

guidance.value: around 9% post brand spend; 9.5% to 10% next year vs ~13% normal
guidance.quote: we should be making around 9% margin in the current year post these expenses

guidance.value: at least 200 bps better than FY26
guidance.quote: there will be at least 200 basis points better margin than the current year
in the first year, we have planned around INR30 crores the brand expense. And in the subsequent year, around INR40-odd crores
it would be just hardly INR25 crores, INR30 crores of investments
